listing.name: inFAMOUS 2 — infamous2-pc (ThiagoFraga761)
listing.summary: Research project. Upstream reports boot/videos/menus/cutscenes and gameplay EmpireCity→NewMarais, controls/audio/saves,54–130FPS on one9800X3D/RX9070XT Linux PC. Shader first-use spikes and Linux-only backend remain; no Portcove run. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own PS3 inFAMOUS2 BCUS98125 version01.00 disc tree and decrypted PS3_GAME/USRDIR/EBOOT.elf; own PS3 dev_flash firmware. Derived code stays local.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Manual source route: scripts/setup.sh fetches pinned ps3recomp plus title patch; lift.sh translates own PPU/SPU EBOOT, build.sh produces work/port/build-vk; launch through the documented own-disc work/play.sh route.
